note: SYNTHETIC labels for the 0.1.11 N3 live eval (SPEC 8.2), written by the worker by reading every posting line against every line of the synthetic master (fixtures/pick/master.md, its medium and large sizes); TO BE REVIEWED by a person: they decide what 'better' means. Per posting: 'rows' is the requirement list an assessment should extract (the lines of the posting's requirement sections only: duties are not rows, assess.md 'WHAT COUNTS AS A REQUIREMENT'), each with the class the 0.1.11 rules give it (OD2 and the orchestrator's review of 2026-10-05: the posting's WORDING decides. A list worded as required is one 'askable' row an item; a list of three or more tools worded as examples, or with no wording either way, is one 'list_item' row an item; one or two tools on a line are 'askable'; 'A, B or similar' is one row with alternatives), the posting wording behind that class ('class_basis'), and the master lines that support it: 'strong' (a line that settles the requirement: a question about it is a question the master already answers), 'support' (a line that bears on it without settling it) and 'skills' (only a Skills line names it). 'status' is the list of statuses a reviewer accepts for a master size; when absent it is derived: a strong line held -> met; only support or skills held -> met or unclear; nothing held -> unclear (askable, list_item), unclear or unmet (hard, nice_to_have). 'class' is a list when a reviewer accepts more than one reading. 'verdicts' are the model verdicts a reviewer accepts per master size and 'gate' the resume gate decisions of SPEC 1.5 (suggest, hold_question, hold_unmet, not_a_match). 'pick' is what the selection checks of SPEC 3.5 read: the pick eval's own labels for its postings ('from_pick_eval'), else the rows above plus 'duties' (lines of 'What you will do', each with its supporting lines, counted as mandatory as the pick eval counts them) and the 'must_keep' groups (any one line of a group satisfies it). 'pick: false' on a row keeps it out of the selection checks (a years line: the role dates evidence it and every selection prints them). An id a master size does not hold is ignored for that size.
